paper_title: Shifting Long-Context LLMs Research from Input to Output
caption: Proportion of real-user demand: The aforementioned 2K range refers to the interval [2K, 4K), and similarly for the other ranges. Solid color fill for input demand, slash fill for output demand in the Wildchat dataset.
model_annotation: The figure is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating counts of real-user demand in the Wildchat dataset split into input demand (solid fill) and output demand (diagonal slash hatch) across four context-length ranges labeled by legend as 2K, 4K, 8K, and 16K. The category axis is the horizontal axis, showing four bar groups arranged left to right in increasing range (2K, 4K, 8K, 16K), with no explicit x-axis label visible; each group contains two adjacent bars corresponding to input and output. The value axis is the vertical axis labeled "Number" on a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 120,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 20,000. In the 2K group, the solid pale-yellow bar (2K-Input) is labeled 9,320 and the hatched pale-yellow bar (2K-Output) is labeled 78,188; in the 4K group, the solid salmon bar (4K-Input) is labeled 3,784 and the hatched salmon bar (4K-Output) is labeled 108,494; in the 8K group, the solid light-blue bar (8K-Input) is labeled 1,401 and the hatched light-blue bar (8K-Output) is labeled 17,865; in the 16K group, the solid dark-blue bar (16K-Input) is labeled 832 and the hatched dark-blue bar (16K-Output) is labeled 4,247. Bars have black outlines and numeric value annotations above each bar, and the groups appear ordered by the context-length range rather than by bar height; a legend at the bottom maps colors and hatch styles to the input/output series for each range.
